explanation: Brain scans show activity throughout the brain over a day, and damage to almost any area causes problems. The brain is about 2% of body weight but uses about a fifth of its energy.
learnMore: Ten percent of the brain myth

claims.text: Humans use virtually all of their brain, not only about 10% of it.
Brain imaging shows activity across virtually all brain regions over the course of a day.
Damage to almost any area of the brain causes some loss of function.
The brain makes up about 2% of body weight but uses about 20% of the body's energy at rest.
